tools.name: browse_open_jobs
tools.description: Use when a maker or creator asks for work, commissions or gigs they could take on: lists open jobs buyers have posted (title, country, budget, when posted). Buyer identities and full briefs stay private; makers sign up free to see details and quote.

tools.name: search_shop_items
tools.description: Use when someone wants to buy something handmade or 3D-printed that already exists (a gift, decor, figurine, prop, part or accessory) rather than commission it: searches items makers sell in The Spool List shop. Returns title, price, maker and a link to the item page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_maker_profile, create_job_request_link · Private data: browse_open_jobs, search_design_library, find_local_services, create_job_request_link · Public sink: create_job_request_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_maker_profile, create_job_request_link · Private data: browse_open_jobs, search_design_library, find_local_services, create_job_request_link · Public sink: create_job_request_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
